name: 11ai-web-design
description: Apply the 11ai visual language or a deliberate content-led direction to elegant, accessible web interfaces, or build a repository-driven project website.

interface.shortDescription: 11ai styling, visual systems, and project sites.
interface.longDescription: A visual design toolkit for applying the standard extracted from v0/www, giving an existing interface a deliberate direction using its own content, components, and theme system, or building a new project website whose content and catalog pages are generated straight from the repository.
defaultPrompt: Apply the 11ai style to this interface.
Make this dashboard compact and data-rich.
Give this existing UI a deliberate visual direction.
Design accessible shadcn charts for this data.
Build a project website for this repository.
